prompt: What did the woman already buy?

options.whyZh: 女方才決定帶車，原先買的是步行乘客票。
男方請他們把自行車鎖在停車架上，沒有說女方之前買了鎖。

options.text: Two seats on the eleven o’clock ferry.
options.zh: 十一點渡輪的兩個座位。
options.whyZh: 她買的是十點那班的乘客票，而不是十一點班次。

options.text: Two passenger tickets for the ten o’clock ferry.
options.zh: 十點渡輪的兩張乘客票。
options.whyZh: 女方開頭說買了兩張十點班次的步行乘客票。

explanationZh: 女方開頭說買了兩張十點班次的步行乘客票。
evidence: I bought two walk-on tickets for the ten o’clock ferry. We decided to bring our bicycles. Can we just show the same tickets at the ramp?

evidenceSpans.speaker: F
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: I bought two walk-on tickets for the ten o’clock ferry. We decided to bring our bicycles. Can we just show the same tickets at the ramp?

vocabulary.note: walk-on 指不搭載車輛而步行登船。
